description: Gets a racing driver's season by league code and driver slug, such as f1 and charles-leclerc: the team they drive for, their place, points and wins in the drivers' championship, their season's starts, wins, podiums, poles, best finish, best grid slot and retirements, the next session, and every Grand Prix they have raced with their grid slot, finish, status and points in the race and sprint and their place in qualifying. Answers "where is Leclerc in the championship", "how many podiums has Norris got this year" and "where did Hamilton finish in Monaco".

code.description: The league's code, in any case.

season.description: The season's year; null for the current one.

slug.description: The driver's slug, such as charles-leclerc.

name: get_series_driver

abbreviation.description: The timing-screen code, such as LEC.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2; null when the provider gives none.

number.description: The car number they last raced with.

photoUrl.description: Their photo; null when none is stored.

ingesting.description: Whether ingestion is switched on; a league switched off still answers, with scores that no longer move.

sport.description: The sport's code (SOCCER), which decides a screen's words: a soccer board shows matches, not games.

next.description: The next session not yet over, with its track; null when the season is done.

endTime.description: When it is due to end; null when the provider gives no length.

lap.description: While a race or sprint is live, the lap the leader is on, when the provider counts it.

laps.description: While a race or sprint is live, the laps it is planned to run.

meetingSlug.description: The meeting's evergreen slug, such as monaco-grand-prix.

name.description: The stage as an event names it, such as Qualifying.

places.description: The classification, first place first, as far as the page shows it; empty until there is one.

abbreviation.description: The timing-screen code, such as LEC.

fastestLap.description: In a race or sprint, the session's fastest lap (1:22.167) on the car that set it; null on every other car.

part.description: In qualifying, the part its best lap was set in and its place decided: Q3, Q1, SQ2.

status.description: classified, dnf, dns, dsq or nc.

time.description: In a race or sprint, the winner's time or another car's interval to it (+12.594, +1 Lap); in practice or qualifying, the car's best lap (1:13.978).

stage.description: The stage's code, such as qualifying or race.

state.description: scheduled, live, final, cancelled or postponed.

trackUrl.description: The meeting's track outline, its mark on a card; null when that season's circuit isn't drawn.

races.description: Every Grand Prix of the season they have a place in, in date order.

region.description: Its state or region, read as a game's venue reads it (Of).

season.description: The season shown; null for a league with no meetings.

standing.description: Their line in the drivers' championship; null before they have one.

behind.description: Points behind the leader; null for the leader.

team.description: The team they drive for: the one they last raced for in the season, else their latest seat.

aliases.description: The other addresses the team answers to within its league (ClubAddresses), which move a reader to Slug; empty for most.

hashtags.description: Its hashtags in English, each led by #: those that go with the first of its English accounts that has any (SocialHashtags); empty when none does. Always a list.

kind.description: club, solo (one athlete, by that athlete's name) or national.

logoIsFallback.description: Whether LogoUrl fell back to the league mark, which may indicate a missing team mark.

logoUrl.description: The team's logo URL; always present, since resolution falls back to the league mark.

name.description: The name as the reader's culture shows it: an operator's name for that culture or English, else the stored one.

slug.description: The team's address within its league, from the stored name, so a renamed team keeps its links.

standing.description: Its place in the league's table, where the provider publishes one; null for every league without a table pull.

computedAt.description: When the provider last computed the table (UTC).

form.description: The last five results, oldest first, as W, D and L; null early in a season.

group.description: The table the team plays in, for a competition of several: Group A; null for a league of one table.

points.description: Points as the provider counts them, so a deduction is included.

rank.description: The table position, by the league's own tie-breaks.

zone.description: The zone the position falls in, in the provider's words: Relegation - Championship; null mid-table.

totals.description: The season's numbers, counted from the stored classifications.

bestFinish.description: Their best race finish; null before they finish one.

bestGrid.description: Their best grid slot in a race; null before one is known.

points.description: Points from races and sprints, counted from their places; the championship line is the provider's.

retirements.description: Races they did not finish or were not classified in.

starts.description: Races started: every race classified with them in it, but one they did not start.
